Vinegar is classified as an acid. What does this tell you about the concentration of the
hydrogen ions and the hydroxide ions?

options.A: Vinegar has a lower concentration of hydrogen ions than hydroxide ions
options.B: Vinegar has an excess of hydrogen ions with respect to hydroxide ions

questions.stem_text: Why does milk \textquotedblleftspoil\textquotedblright when kept in a refrigerator?

options.A: Lactose crystallization at low temperatures causes milk to spoil
options.B: Milk spoils due to absorption of odors in the fridge
options.C: Milk spoils due to the presence of mesophiles
options.D: Milk spoils due to chemical reactions in the fridge
options.E: Thermophiles cause milk to spoil in the refrigerator

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Lactose crystallization at low temperatures causes milk to spoil

questions.stem_text:
What is the evidence for the theory that theneurilemma sheathplays a role in the
regeneration of severed nerves?

options.A: The neurilemma sheath absorbs toxins at the injury site to facilitate regeneration.
options.B: The neurilemma sheath provides a channel for the axon to grow back to its former position.
options.C: The neurilemma sheath fuses severed axon ends together.
options.D: The neurilemma sheath repels inhibitory molecules that prevent nerve growth.
options.E: The neurilemma sheath acts as a source of neural stem cells for regeneration.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The neurilemma sheath provides a channel for the axon to grow back to its former position.
